description: This file is a shell script for testing git add -u functionality, including various test cases for different scenarios.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, executes provided commands and checks their outcome.

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Checks that the output from previous command is empty.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Checks that the previous command failed.

methods.name: test_grep
methods.description: Searches for pattern in output or file.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the internal clock in tests.
